summary: Pacific Booker Minerals filed a 6-K reporting that its special committee received an independent fairness opinion from INFOR Financial deeming the unsolicited hostile bid by American Eagle Gold Corp. inadequate. The company is conducting a strategic review to maximize shareholder value, exploring change-of-control transactions, asset sales, partnerships, or remaining independent. An advisor, RCI Capital Group, has initiated outreach to potential counterparties after establishing a technical dataroom. A technical review of the Morrison Project by Tetra Tech is due mid-2026. A C$3 million financing supports these initiatives. Watch for competing bids or a higher offer from the hostile bidder, with a possible regulatory timetable.
